result.brief: 提出 SurgWMBench，面向手术世界模型的短时程器械运动规划与动力学预测基准，评估未来器械运动预测及连续 rollout 与输入扰动下的稳定性。
result.reason: Benchmark for surgical world models jointly modeling visual state transitions and instrument motion dynamics, with rollout stability evaluation; directly matches video world model and action-conditioned prediction interests.
